failure_family: Layer-B native-owner object bootstrap compile ownership and provenance
history: packet8 failed review on command, environment, lifecycle, inspection and dependency provenance
correction9 fixed several findings but still failed command/lifecycle/temporary-input distinctions
object-only packet10 changed the compile strategy but its include baseline rejected installed unconsumed external symlink directories
bounded correction11 admitted those links but mistakenly required the separately pinned source to belong to the header baseline
decision: Stop prose-only corrections. Encode the object-only compile plan, source/header classification, lifecycle state machine, evidence records and execute gate in a small controller with side-effect-free parser/state tests. Obtain independent source review before any controller execution or compiler/systemd command.
required_separation: The exact source has its own pinned pre/post identity and is never required to be a member of the header baseline.
Header prerequisites must be present unchanged in the non-following approved-root baseline and must not traverse excluded external-directory links.
Generated .i/.s/.o/.d artifacts and ephemeral private scratch entries are not persistent prerequisites.
The execute path is unreachable without explicit --execute and exact reviewed hashes; import and dry parsing have no subprocess or filesystem mutation side effects.
